item.title: Aster
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: RusK
  • 発売日: 2007-11-09
  • スコア: 7.62/10 (107 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Aster
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

Aster tells the story of four young men, whose lives are connected by one incident.

It all begins with Hiro Sakaki. He is a high school student, and enjoys his life with his old friends, Saki and Saya, twin sisters.

Under the summer sun, their relationships change little by little…

“No miracles will occur there——

But even so, hope remains”

Spring… the season of start. We met again in that season among cherry trees. I wanted to meet you, I wanted to talk to you, I wanted to walk along with you…. One of my wishes has come true. How about others? Our spring has started with full of hopes. Spring… the season of start. Our story starts from here….
